tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You are a student who recently applied for a summer internship at a company. You have received an email from the personnel manager, Mr. Davis, asking you to provide additional documents and information to complete your application. Write an email to Mr. Davis.
bullets: Thank him for considering your application.
Explain what interests you most about the job for which you are applying.
List the additional documents and information you are sending.
tasks.subject: Summer Internship Application Documents
